args.code: (() => { const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab, .shop-tab, [class*=tab]'); for (let tab of tabs) { if (tab.textContent.includes('出售作物')) { tab.click(); return 'clicked sell tab'; } } const all = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (let el of all) { if (el.textContent.trim() === '出售作物' || el.textContent.includes('💰 出售作物')) { el.click(); return 'clicked sell: ' + el.tagName; } } return 'sell tab not found'; })()
